text: また　きたんだな　レッド！

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んだ is the spoken form of のだ, which shows the speaker has taken in a fact and is remarking on it. きたんだ = 'so you came'.

patterns.name: 〜な
patterns.explanation: な at the end is a manly way of saying something half to yourself, like 'huh'. きたんだな = 'so you've come, huh'.
